# 🌌 Void Arsenal

Tired of standard swords that just deal more damage? **Void Arsenal** introduces unique, dynamic weapons with special abilities, physics-based combat, and spectacular visual effects!

To craft these legendary weapons, you must first forge the **Void Alloy** — a powerful new material. We highly recommend playing with **JEI (Just Enough Items)** to see the crafting recipes!

---

## ⚔️ The Arsenal

### ⚡ Thunderstorm Axe (Throw & Return)
Feel like a god of thunder! 
* **Right-Click:** Throw the axe like a projectile. Upon impact, it summons a devastating lightning bolt!
* **Return Mechanic:** After striking, the axe automatically flies back into your hand, passing through any obstacles.

### 💨 Phantom Katana (Dash Attack)
Master the art of teleportation.
* **Right-Click:** Instantly dash forward (up to 7 blocks). Any enemy caught in your path takes massive damage, and you end up right behind them for a stylish finish.

### 🌍 Earthquake Hammer (AoE Knockback)
Control the battlefield with pure kinetic force.
* **Right-Click:** Slam the ground to create a shockwave. It deals area-of-effect damage and violently launches all surrounding enemies into the air!

### ❄️ Glacial Lance (Crowd Control)
Stop your enemies dead in their tracks.
* **Right-Click:** Fire a piercing beam of frost. The first enemy hit takes damage, gets encased in a block of ice, and is inflicted with extreme Slowness.

---

### 🔧 Installation & Requirements
* Requires **Minecraft Forge 1.20.1**
* **Client & Server:** Fully functional in both singleplayer and multiplayer.
